findings.finding: Financing overhang inside the window. Cash was $12.0m at 2026-06-30 after H1 operating burn of $8.1m, so Sept 30 cash should be about $8m (my estimate; the release states it), roughly two quarters of runway. The chairman's second RSU tranche is conditional on a financing of at least $6.5m gross (proxy, 2026-09-28). The six-month restriction on variable-rate deals from the June placement runs out around 2026-12-18. A Special General Meeting on 2026-11-19 votes on reverse splits of 5:1 to 40:1, because the stock has been below $1 since 2026-10-28. On a name worth about $4.2m (about 5.3m shares at $0.80), the release or call may well carry going-concern language or an offering.

findings.why_not_priced: A stock trading at about half of estimated net cash has priced a dilutive raise as likely; what it has not priced is when and at what discount. If the market had fully priced a raise on Nov 18, the stock would not hold at a market cap below cash, and the Nov 9 patent headline would not have bought +20.7% on 727k shares. A raise announced with the print, or going-concern language, would still reprice a $4m float.
findings.independence: Reverse-split SGM notice 2026-11-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1584371/000121390026114985/ea031043801ex99-1.htm); H1 cash and burn (https://ir.icecure-medical.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/234/icecure-reports-its-financial-results-for-the-first-half-of-2026-with-45-revenue-growth-year-over-year/); June placement 6-K with the variable-rate restriction (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1584371/000121390026070172/ea0295200-6k_icecure.htm). On lesson 4, what the money buys: the US ramp (active sites up from 19 to more than 30) and the FDA-mandated ChoICE study. That is real use, but revenue of about $0.9m a quarter against burn of about $4m means the raise funds survival rather than a demonstrated ramp, so the finding stays negative.

The part not priced is a print that shows no raise and a lower burn: in that case the discount would not be this deep, and the stock would not keep making new lows on 50-150k shares a day.

A $0.1m beat is about 12% of revenue on a thin name, but the line has not paid on its own (H1's beat was sold the next day).

The Category III code and roughly $4,000 Medicare facility payment continue. The call will have to address the reimbursement path, and reimbursement benefits are not expected before about 2028.

findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced (the stock is down about 30% since). The residual is any management statement on the call that US adoption is slowing for lack of the code. If that were priced, US-site commentary would not be the Street's stated bar.
